rules: Deep Industrial Black #0D1117 is the only background fill.
Steel Gray #2B313A is strictly for 1px lines, grid backgrounds, and borders.
Graph Cyan #00C2FF is a SIGNAL. Never use it as a base fill, only for active states, data lines, hover traces, and focus states.
Accent Glow Blue #1F8FFF is ONLY used as a faint 10-15% opacity blur behind cyan elements.
NO gradients on white, NO purple/violet, NO teal/green. Stick exclusively to the palette.

layout_and_spacing.grid: 12-column grid system. Matte black background with fixed 5% blueprint grid overlay.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #2B313A. Edges must be sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm/2px). No soft radiuses.

header.style: Sticky, z-50, backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0D1117]/80, border-b border-[#2B313A].
header.logo: Text-based wordmark 'TASC' (Montserrat Semibold) with tagline 'TENACIOUS AUTOMATION SYSTEMS & CONTROLS' (Orbitron text-[10px] tracking-widest).
header.nav_links: Anchor links (//01..//08), Orbitron text-xs tracking-widest. Hover state: text-[#00C2FF].

buttons.primary: Border-only (1px #2B313A), background transparent. Text Soft White. On hover/focus: border-[#00C2FF], subtle glow shadow, text-[#00C2FF]. Brackets around text e.g., '[ INITIATE ]'.

cards.base: bg-transparent, border border-[#2B313A], rounded-[2px], p-8, relative overflow-hidden.
cards.hover: Cyan border trace via CSS/framer-motion, top-right Orbitron '[ + ]' indicator appears or glows.

inputs.style: bg-[#0D1117] border-b border-[#2B313A] rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-[#E6EDF3] placeholder:text-[#2B313A]. Outline-none.

01_hero.layout: Min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden.

visuals.background: Blueprint grid with a cyan scanning line sweeping top to bottom every 10s (CSS linear-gradient + animation).
visuals.graphic: Abstract isometric SVG network map (PLCs, servers, substation). Path strokes in #2B313A. Cyan dots/pulses animating along paths using stroke-dashoffset or motion.circle.

01_hero.content: Kicker: '[ SYSTEM ONLINE / SECURE CONNECTION ]' with blinking cursor. H1: 'Architecting the Industrial Nervous System.'. 2 CTAs.

02_core_capabilities.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1}. Size 32px. Automation (Server/Cpu), SCADA (Monitor/Activity), Networking (Network/Wifi), EMS (Zap/Leaf), IIoT (Cloud/Radio), Architecture (Layers/Workflow).
02_core_capabilities.interactions: Hover causes card border to illuminate cyan, and an Orbitron '[ + ]' text to light up in the top right.

03_interoperability.layout: Vertical pipeline down the center. 5 distinct nodes.
03_interoperability.visuals: Thick vertical central line (#2B313A). As user scrolls (GSAP ScrollTrigger), the line fills with #00C2FF segment by segment.
03_interoperability.nodes: Left/Right alternating. When scroll reaches a node, it lights up cyan, and small Orbitron metrics (TAGS: 12,480, UPTIME: 99.98%) fade in.

04_dashboard_showcase.layout: Full-width layered SCADA mockups. Fake 3D perspective using CSS transform: rotateX(20deg) rotateZ(-10deg) scale(0.9) or similar.
04_dashboard_showcase.visuals: Constructed with HTML/CSS. Utility bar chart, alarm list, trend line chart, KPI tiles (OEE, PF).
04_dashboard_showcase.interactions: Scroll parallax (layers move at different speeds). Orbitron numbers tick dynamically (use React useEffect interval to randomly fluctuate numbers like real telemetry).

05_industries.layout: Minimalist horizontal accordion (flex-row, flex-1 transition-all duration-500).
05_industries.items: Oil & Gas, Water, Manufacturing, Power, Food & Beverage, Infrastructure.
05_industries.visuals: NO PHOTOS. Abstract custom-drawn SVG line-art per industry (e.g., Oil Rig silhouette, factory roofline, transmission tower). Stroke #2B313A, 1.5px.
05_industries.interactions: On hover/click: accordion panel expands, SVG stroke lights up #00C2FF, subtle #1F8FFF/10 background glow.

06_engineering_method.visuals: Styled like a compressed Gantt chart or blueprint timeline. Horizontal line connecting them.
06_engineering_method.interactions: Horizontal wipe/slide reveal on scroll entry.

07_founder_mindset.layout: Grid cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12. Left: abstract engineering SVG (calipers, circuit node, schematic geometry). Right: Body copy.

08_contact.left_panel: Terminal-style form. Inputs: bottom-border only. Button: '[ TRANSMIT DATA ]'. Focus: cyan bounding box.
08_contact.right_panel: Slim column of quick section links and operational data (e.g., Lat/Long, Support hours).

motion_and_interactions.engine: Framer Motion or GSAP. Preferred: GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-linked data lines and clip-path reveals.
motion_and_interactions.easing: power2.out, expo.out, or linear (for continuous scanning/data pulses). NO BOUNCING. NO ELASTICITY. Must feel mechanical and precise.
motion_and_interactions.durations: Data pulses: 2s-3s linear. Section reveals: 0.8s power2.out. Hover states: 0.2s ease.

anti_ai_rules.1: DO NOT use generic blob shapes or soft shadows. The aesthetic is SCADA terminal/OT dashboard—sharp, grid-based, engineering.
anti_ai_rules.2: DO NOT use photos from unspash/pexels. All visuals must be CSS or SVG line-art.
anti_ai_rules.3: DO NOT center text unless it's a specific UI button or metric. Left-align headings and body to match technical documentation/terminal readout styles.
anti_ai_rules.4: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Montserrat for headings, Orbitron for kickers/numbers. This is fixed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` for basic icons (use strokeWidth={1.5} max).
Install `framer-motion` or `gsap` for animations. Ensure precise control without bounce.

For the hero background, use CSS: `background-image: linear-gradient(#2B313A 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #2B313A 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 40px 40px;` with very low opacity.
Build the dashboard perspective section using raw Tailwind transforms: `transform perspective-1000 rotateX(15deg) rotateY(-10deg)`.
Use raw inline `<svg>` elements for the Industries section. Draw simple paths (e.g., `<path d='M10 50 L30 10 L50 50...'/>`). Do NOT use image tags.
Add `data-testid` to all navigation links, the contact form inputs, and the submit button.
Do NOT build multiple pages or react-router. Build a single `App.js` or `index.js` with anchor scrolling.
Adhere STRICTLY to the 5 colors provided in the palette. No deviations.
